children.zh: 需要随滚动固定在指定位置的内容。
children.en: Content to pin at the configured position while scrolling.

children.zh: 未提供有效 message 时展示的提示正文。
children.en: Alert message content used when message is falsy.

children.zh: 列表面板主体，位于工具栏之后、底部区域之前。
children.en: Main list-panel content between its toolbar and footer.

children.zh: 头像内的文本或自定义内容，在图片和图标未显示时使用。
children.en: Avatar text or custom content used when no image or icon is displayed.

children.zh: 要组合展示的 Avatar 子节点；超出 maxCount 的部分由组处理。
children.en: Avatar children to group; the group handles items exceeding maxCount.

children.zh: 被徽标标记的内容；省略时可独立显示徽标。
children.en: Content decorated by the badge; omit it for a standalone badge.

children.zh: 组合展示的按钮内容，继承组提供的尺寸与形状。
children.en: Grouped button content that inherits the group's size and shape.

children.zh: 卡片主体内容，与头部和封面分开。
children.en: Card body content, separate from the header and cover.

children.zh: 未设置 label 时的复选框标签内容。
children.en: Checkbox label content used when label is null or undefined.

children.zh: 自定义 Checkbox 子节点，与组的选中值共享上下文。
children.en: Custom Checkbox children sharing the group's selection context.

children.zh: 选择卡标题和描述之后的自定义内容。
children.en: Custom content following the check card's title and description.

children.zh: 未通过 options 生成选项时使用的 CheckCard 子节点。
children.en: CheckCard children used when options is not supplied.

children.zh: 折叠面板子节点；Collapse 根据 panelKey 注入展开状态和切换处理。
children.en: Panel children; Collapse injects expansion state and handlers using panelKey.

children.zh: 面板展开区域的正文；显示与收起由 active 控制。
children.en: Panel body whose visibility is controlled by active.

active.zh: 当前面板是否展开；在 Collapse 中通常由父组件根据 openKeys 注入。
active.en: Whether the panel is expanded; normally injected by Collapse from openKeys.

onExpand.zh: 可操作标题被点击或键盘激活时回传 panelKey；Collapse 使用它切换展开状态。
onExpand.en: Receives panelKey when an enabled header is clicked or keyboard-activated; Collapse uses it to toggle expansion.

children.zh: 要排版的 DescriptionsItem 子节点，使用其 label、span 和内容。
children.en: DescriptionsItem children laid out using their label, span and content.

children.zh: 当前描述项的值或自定义内容，不是标签。
children.en: The value or custom content of this description item, not its label.

children.zh: 抽屉正文区域内容。
children.en: Content of the drawer body.

children.zh: 下拉触发器；弹层内容请放在 overlay 中。
children.en: Dropdown trigger; put popup content in overlay instead.

children.zh: 分裂式下拉按钮主按钮的内容；菜单使用 overlay。
children.en: Content of the main split button; supply the menu through overlay.

children.zh: 水平分割线中的标题内容；有效时优先于 text。
children.en: Title content in a horizontal divider; when truthy it takes precedence over text.

children.zh: 空状态底部区域，通常用于操作按钮。
children.en: Footer content of the empty state, usually action buttons.

children.zh: 字段控件及辅助内容；支持的表单控件通过 prop 接入 Form 字段上下文。
children.en: Field controls and supporting content; supported controls bind to the Form field through prop.

children.zh: 参与 Flex 排列的子内容。
children.en: Children arranged by the flex container.

children.zh: 功能卡片正文中的附加自定义内容。
children.en: Additional custom content in the feature-card body.

children.zh: 组合展示的输入框、按钮等内容，使用组的布局及外观上下文。
children.en: Inputs, buttons or other content sharing the group's layout and appearance context.

children.zh: 布局主内容区域的内容。
children.en: Content of the layout's main section.

suffixCls.zh: 布局实现使用的基础类名后缀，生成 k-<suffixCls>；普通样式扩展应使用 className。
suffixCls.en: Base class suffix used by the layout implementation to form k-<suffixCls>; use className for ordinary styling extensions.

children.zh: 布局底部区域的内容。
children.en: Content of the layout footer.

suffixCls.zh: 布局实现使用的基础类名后缀，生成 k-<suffixCls>；普通样式扩展应使用 className。
suffixCls.en: Base class suffix used by the layout implementation to form k-<suffixCls>; use className for ordinary styling extensions.

children.zh: 布局头部区域的内容。
children.en: Content of the layout header.

suffixCls.zh: 布局实现使用的基础类名后缀，生成 k-<suffixCls>；普通样式扩展应使用 className。
suffixCls.en: Base class suffix used by the layout implementation to form k-<suffixCls>; use className for ordinary styling extensions.

children.zh: 布局子区域，如 Header、Content、Sider 和 Footer；嵌套布局也可作为内容。
children.en: Layout sections such as Header, Content, Sider and Footer, including nested layouts.

suffixCls.zh: 布局实现使用的基础类名后缀，生成 k-<suffixCls>；普通样式扩展应使用 className。
suffixCls.en: Base class suffix used by the layout implementation to form k-<suffixCls>; use className for ordinary styling extensions.

children.zh: 侧栏内容，如导航菜单；宽度和折叠由 Sider 属性控制。
children.en: Sidebar content such as navigation; Sider props control width and collapse.

suffixCls.zh: 布局实现使用的基础类名后缀，生成 k-<suffixCls>；普通样式扩展应使用 className。
suffixCls.en: Base class suffix used by the layout implementation to form k-<suffixCls>; use className for ordinary styling extensions.

children.zh: 标准弹窗正文；传入真值 content 时将替换整个标准内容区，包括头部、正文和页脚。
children.en: Standard modal body; a truthy content prop replaces the entire standard content region, including header, body and footer.

className.zh: 追加到 k-modal 根容器的 CSS 类名。
className.en: Additional CSS classes on the k-modal root container.

children.zh: 独立面板的标准正文；真值 content 会替换整个标准内容区。
children.en: Standard body of the standalone panel; truthy content replaces the entire standard content region.

className.zh: 追加到 k-modal-panel 根容器的 CSS 类名。
className.en: Additional CSS classes on the k-modal-panel root container.

children.zh: 页面头部主体中的附加内容。
children.en: Additional content in the page-header body.

children.zh: 气泡卡片的触发内容；卡片正文使用 content。
children.en: Trigger content for the popover; supply its body through content.

children.zh: 确认气泡的触发内容，不是气泡正文。
children.en: Trigger content for the confirmation popup, not its body.

children.zh: 未设置 label 时的单选项标签内容。
children.en: Radio label content used when label is null or undefined.

children.zh: 未设置 label 时的按钮式单选标签，二者均无内容时回退到 value。
children.en: Button-style radio label when label is null or undefined; falls back to value when both are absent.

children.zh: 自定义 Radio 或 RadioButton 子节点，共享组的值和禁用状态。
children.en: Custom Radio or RadioButton children sharing the group value and disabled state.

children.zh: 以 Option 子节点声明的选项；使用 options 数据源时无需重复声明。
children.en: Options declared as Option children; do not duplicate options already supplied through the options data source.

children.zh: 接收 locale、尺寸、主题和形状配置的后代组件。
children.en: Descendant components receiving locale, size, theme and shape configuration.

children.zh: 按配置的间距和方向排列的内容；compact 时组合相邻控件。
children.en: Content arranged with the configured spacing and direction; compact combines adjacent controls.

children.zh: 加载状态覆盖的内容；省略内容时作为独立加载指示器使用。
children.en: Content covered by the loading state; omit it for a standalone loading indicator.

children.zh: 步骤子节点；容器根据 current 等属性分配步骤序号与状态。
children.en: Step children whose indices and statuses are assigned by the container using current and related props.

children.zh: 提示的触发内容；提示文本使用 title。
children.en: Tooltip trigger content; provide tooltip text through title.

children.zh: 当前标签页的内容区域。
children.en: Content of this tab pane.

children.zh: TabPanel 子节点，用于生成页签导航和对应面板。
children.en: TabPanel children used to build tab navigation and panes.

children.zh: 标签正文，与关闭按钮独立。
children.en: Tag body content, separate from the close button.

children.zh: 栅格列内部的内容。
children.en: Content inside the grid column.

children.zh: 参与栅格行排列的 Col 等子节点。
children.en: Col and other children arranged within the grid row.

children.zh: 可见项渲染函数，接收数据项和它在完整 data 数组中的索引；不会渲染所有项。
children.en: Renderer for visible items, receiving the item and its index in the full data array; not every item is rendered.

children.zh: 骨架不再显示时展示的实际内容；加载期间展示骨架占位。
children.en: Actual content displayed after the skeleton is hidden; loading displays the skeleton placeholder.

children.zh: 骨架不再显示时展示的实际内容；加载期间展示骨架占位。
children.en: Actual content displayed after the skeleton is hidden; loading displays the skeleton placeholder.

children.zh: 骨架不再显示时展示的实际内容；加载期间展示骨架占位。
children.en: Actual content displayed after the skeleton is hidden; loading displays the skeleton placeholder.

children.zh: 骨架不再显示时展示的实际内容；加载期间展示骨架占位。
children.en: Actual content displayed after the skeleton is hidden; loading displays the skeleton placeholder.

children.zh: 骨架不再显示时展示的实际内容；加载期间展示骨架占位。
children.en: Actual content displayed after the skeleton is hidden; loading displays the skeleton placeholder.

children.zh: 未使用 value 覆盖且尚未编辑时展示的排版内容；其文本也用于初始化编辑值。
children.en: Typography content shown before editing when value is not supplied; its text also initializes the editable value.

children.zh: 未使用 value 覆盖且尚未编辑时展示的排版内容；其文本也用于初始化编辑值。
children.en: Typography content shown before editing when value is not supplied; its text also initializes the editable value.

children.zh: 未使用 value 覆盖且尚未编辑时展示的排版内容；其文本也用于初始化编辑值。
children.en: Typography content shown before editing when value is not supplied; its text also initializes the editable value.

children.zh: 未使用 value 覆盖且尚未编辑时展示的排版内容；其文本也用于初始化编辑值。
children.en: Typography content shown before editing when value is not supplied; its text also initializes the editable value.

menuKey.zh: 菜单身份标识的兼容回退值，仅在未设置 itemKey 时使用；新代码优先使用 itemKey。
menuKey.en: Compatibility fallback for item identity, used only when itemKey is absent; prefer itemKey in new code.

className.zh: 追加到菜单项 li 元素的 CSS 类名。
className.en: Additional CSS classes on the menu item's li element.

style.zh: 菜单项 li 元素的内联样式；内联模式嵌套缩进可能覆盖 paddingLeft。
style.en: Inline styles on the menu item's li element; nested inline-menu indentation may override paddingLeft.

menuKey.zh: 菜单身份标识的兼容回退值，仅在未设置 itemKey 时使用；新代码优先使用 itemKey。
menuKey.en: Compatibility fallback for item identity, used only when itemKey is absent; prefer itemKey in new code.

type.zh: 消息语义类型，影响状态类名和默认图标；icon 可覆盖默认图标。
type.en: Semantic message type controlling status classes and the default icon; icon can override that icon.

closable.zh: 是否显示关闭按钮；点击时调用 onClose，独立面板由调用方处理移除。
closable.en: Whether to show the close button; clicking calls onClose, and the caller handles removal of a standalone panel.

type.zh: 消息语义类型，影响状态类名和默认图标；icon 可覆盖默认图标。
type.en: Semantic message type controlling status classes and the default icon; icon can override that icon.

closable.zh: 共享面板类型中的属性；当前 NoticePanel 始终显示关闭按钮，此属性不会隐藏它。
closable.en: A prop inherited from the shared panel type; NoticePanel currently always shows its close button, so this prop does not hide it.

checked.zh: 选项是否选中，控制选中样式；通常由 Select 根据选中值注入。
checked.en: Whether the option is selected, controlling selected styling; normally injected by Select from its selected value.

active.zh: 选项的活动高亮状态，与选中状态不同，通常由 Select 的键盘导航管理。
active.en: Active highlight state, distinct from selection and normally managed by Select keyboard navigation.

onMouseEnter.zh: 鼠标进入可用选项时触发，接收 React 鼠标事件；禁用项不触发。
onMouseEnter.en: Called with the React mouse event when the pointer enters an enabled option; disabled options do not trigger it.
